svg.aria-label: Journey 1: C4 + E4 to B3 + F4. Journey 2: C4 + E4 to D4 + F4. Arrows show which way each voice goes. Nothing is named or counted.
svg.title: Before we name it: two journeys

g.text: Two journeys from the same start
How to read this graphic: Each keyboard starts from the dashed shapes on C4 and E4 and
ends on the solid shapes. Follow the arrows and compare the two journeys with your eyes
and, if you like, with your own keyboard. There are no labels on the endings: that is
deliberate, and the next step supplies the names.
